labels.reason: The new optimizemigration command is a purely additive feature that requires no action.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new RenameIndex operation is an additive option that existing migrations do not need to adopt.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The autodetector now generates RenameIndex instead of RemoveIndex and AddIndex, changing the migrations it produces for index renames.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The autodetector now generates RenameIndex instead of AlterIndexTogether and AddIndex when moving indexes, changing generated migration output.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Window order_by accepting string references is a new additive capability with no required change.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new CONN_HEALTH_CHECKS setting is opt-in and existing deployments are unaffected unless they enable it.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: bulk_create update-on-conflict support is a new additive option that does not change existing calls.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: QuerySet.iterator now prefetches related objects when chunk_size is given, which changes query behavior and counts for existing code.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new ^ XOR operator for Q objects and querysets is additive and does not alter existing queries.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new Field.non_db_attrs attribute is an additive option for custom fields.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: On PostgreSQL, auto fields are now created as identity columns instead of serial sequences, which affects schema generation in migrations and deployments.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Accepting timedelta for max_age in set_cookie is an additive convenience with no action needed.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The new SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS setting is optional and only needed if the user chooses to rotate keys.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Supporting a comma-separated protocol list in SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER extends existing behavior and requires no action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: pre_delete and post_delete now send an extra origin kwarg, which can break receivers whose signatures do not accept additional keyword arguments.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Dropping the requirement for an id attribute on json_script wrappers relaxes markup rules and needs no action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The cached template loader is now enabled by default when DEBUG is True, which changes development behavior so template edits may require a restart unless overridden.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Parallel test support on spawn-based platforms is an added capability that does not require action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: A nested durable atomic block in TestCase now raises RuntimeError, so existing tests relying on the old behavior may fail.
